The first runner to arrive at Mitcham was C. Griffiths, of Hallamshire, who returned fastest time, and to the great surprise of many onlookers he was followed only 12 seconds later by Flower, who had put up a remarkable performance, doing second fastest time and beating the club record by nearly two minutes.
Patience, after a ding-dong battle over the last 700 yards, forced his way to a 10 yards lead over C.
The 2 Miles was a good race, and it was not until half-a-lap from home that Nankivell went into the lead with Charlie Griffiths chasing him home in determined fashion.
